why: Town of St. Paul news post 'Campgrounds Now Open!' (May 23 2025, archived 2025-10-07; the live URL now 404s): 'Reservations for the Overnight Campground are available by phone request only, as this site is not open daily. It is primarily available during weekend community events such as recreational tournaments and Rodeo Week.' Its Campspot park record (overnightcamp, id 4933, read 2026-11-10) says 'PARK IS OPEN BASED ON EVENTS AND SCHEDULING', and the availability API answered 'Park is closed for your dates' on every 2026 summer night probed (Jun 9, Jul 14, Jul 25, Jul 31, Aug 11, Sep 15), while Iron Horse's record on the same API showed free sites on Jul 14. The town's campgrounds pages (read 2026-11-10 in a headless browser) still list it with a May 15 - Sep 23 season, 24 powered / 16 unpowered sites at C$34 / C$24 and phone 780-614-4244, but say nothing about walk-up nights. It is a different place from 9066: 4800 55 Street, behind the RCMP detachment (Google: 4806 55 St, 53.9907,-111.3106) on the west end of town, about 2.7 km W of 9066's pin; Esri 2022 and 2024 imagery show a small gravel loop of grass sites with a central building at about 53.9897,-111.3108, with no rigs in either August capture. Google Maps has no listing of its own: every Overnight Campground query resolved to St. Paul Iron Horse Campground (4012 53 Ave, 53.99598,-111.26979, 4.4 on 47 reviews).
name: Overnight Campground
flags: Lead's C$34 / C$24 and 24 + 16 site figures are this campground's, not 9066's. 9066 Iron Horse Trail Campground checks out against the town pages: the 4012 53 Avenue address, 82 serviced stalls, full service C$44, phone 780-614-4244 and Google's pin about 70 m from ours. The town's Iron Horse table also lists power-only C$34 and no-power C$24 tiers, which 9066's fees (C$44 only, from Campspot's FHU types) leave out.

Event-only reading rests on the 2025 news post plus Campspot's 'open based on events and scheduling' banner and closed dates. The current town page lists a season and rates without repeating the events-only wording. AWH may prefer a keep with a caveat ('mostly open for events; call the caretaker').
